trigger_condition: engine hits a fatal step and emits 'fatal' instead of 'complete'
potential_consequence: Identity bar stays stale after a fatal setup abort even though earlier steps may have written project/config

trigger_condition: user re-enters wizard and completes/aborts again before the prior refreshIdentityOnComplete() read resolves
guard_snippet: track a monotonically increasing token and ignore a resolved read whose token is stale
potential_consequence: Slower earlier read resolves after a newer one and overwrites the identity bar with stale project/account/model data

trigger_condition: bridge.codemieConfig.read() rejects (IPC/Rust read error) right after setup completed
guard_snippet: catch { return; } // keep last-good render instead of blanking to fallback
potential_consequence: A previously correct identity bar is wiped to the unconfigured/product-name fallback on a transient read failure
